packageRules.description: Actions are SHA-pinned; group them so one PR moves the whole set, matching what dependabot did before.
CI tooling pinned in workflow env blocks. Grouped: they are only ever used together, and one PR per scanner is noise.
Helm itself gates the support matrix. Separate PR so the major line is a deliberate decision, never a group side effect.

Chart images. Each gets its own PR: a bump here changes what users run, and the chart version has to move with it. postUpgradeTasks makes 'has to' automatic — the custom manager only rewrites the digest, so bump-chart-version.sh raises Chart.yaml's patch in the same branch, or the digest-only PR fails ci.yaml's version job. Allowed via RENOVATE_ALLOWED_POST_UPGRADE_COMMANDS in renovate.yaml.
kind node images are digest-pinned against a specific Kubernetes line; never move them across minors automatically.

customManagers.description: Image digests in values.yaml. The helm-values manager cannot be used here: it keys off image.tag, and this chart pins by digest with tag left empty so that the digest always wins in searxng.imageRef.
Tool versions pinned in workflow env blocks, e.g. `TRIVY_VERSION: 0.73.0`.
